strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
1. All allies destroyed
Ta-da-daaan!
The Mazinger Corps makes its dashing entrance, I tell ya!
Hey, Boss, knock off the racket. It's embarrassing.
Hmph! Koji,
just 'cause you went to America, quit actin' all goody-goody, I tell ya!
Honestly... Boss could stand to change a little.
So that's the deal, Dr. Hazuki. Mazinger Z is here to help!
Yes, Kabuto. Sorry, but please lend us your strength.
...So "maintenance" really meant keeping it ready for combat...
Heh, Prof. Yumi is a shrewd one.
Hey, Koji, he ain't Dr. Hazuki, he's the Commander now, y'know?
Huh, is that so? You look well too, Fujiwara.
I'm always in top shape. So's Dancougar!
...I wouldn't mind if you were a little quieter, though.
Koji!
Ryoma and the guys are here too? Now nothing can stop us!
So this is Mazinger Z. Heh, never thought I'd fight alongside it.
Oh, a robot I've never seen before...
Zambot 3... We're the Jin Family. Nice to meet you!
Heh, Keiko, we haven't even seen what they can do yet.
No need to bow and scrape like that, is there?
Oh, you said it! I'll show you the power of Mazinger!
As long as Koji doesn't drag us down.
Tetsuya!
Geez, Tetsuya! Why can't you ever say it any other way!?
It's fine! "Koji, let's do our best together!"
...If he said that, I'd figure he was running a fever!
Hmph, fine by me.
They really look like they don't get along...
I hear they once had a huge fight.
Don't bring that up, come on.
Tetsuya was actin' like a little kid, I tell ya.
...Knock it off, Boss.
Now that we've regrouped...
Heh heh heh.
I knew if I kept watch here, this Gandor unit would surely show up!
I'll dispose of you all at once!
Commander! Enemy attack!
No way... an ambush!?
Using cheap tricks!
Baron Ashura!?
You! Weren't you supposed to have died in the last battle!?
Koji Kabuto!
How could I die before taking my revenge on you!? Prepare yourself!
Ugh, they just never quit, I tell ya! What do we do, Kojiii!?
What else is there to do, Boss! Right, Koji?
That's right! I'll remind 'em what Mazinger can do!
Ryo, this pattern... isn't it the same as with the Dinosaur Empire?
Yeah. Something's going on. I've got a bad feeling about this.
Repeated coincidences are no longer coincidence. They're inevitable.
If space is like this too, it'll be rough going.
We can't afford to be held up here. All hands, battle stations!
Heh heh heh heh... Good to see you're doing well, Koji Kabuto.
Huh!? I don't know anybody like you... Ugh!?
Is that really so? Heh heh... Hahahahaha.
That voice... it can't be...
Heh heh heh... True to my name, I've returned from Hell, Koji Kabuto!
What... what is this...!
When Baron Ashura turned up alive, I figured it'd be something like this!
Is Brocken alive and kicking too!? Dr. Hell!
He is already at work on another operation.
...Well, whaddya know.
Looks like you stirred up trouble... Koji.
Was it the Great General of Darkness who revived you!?
Fuhahahaha, with the power of ancient Mykene,
I shall achieve my ambition of world conquest once more!
As if we'd let you do that so easily!
Baron Ashura, I leave this to you.
Not just Mazinger... paint the ground with all their blood!
As you command.
Sounds like there's history here.
Guys we thought we beat are coming back!? Tch, what a pain!
...Let's hope Muge Zorbados doesn't do the same.
D-Don't say such ominous things.
You never know, though. At this point.
What are you dawdling for!
Don't get hasty, Baron Ashura! Mazinger Z and Koji Kabuto
won't run or hide!
Nuohhh, I underestimated you! But Koji Kabuto, this is only the beginning.
We shall meet again!
Quit talking big!
And tell Brocken he can come at me anytime!
Nnnngh! Events are already in motion!
Don't think you can stay cocky forever!
Heh, come up with a better parting line than that!
And don't come back!
...That one's pretty cliche too, Koji.
Yeah. Dr. Hell and a mysterious army... This is getting troublesome.
What's up, Tetsuya? Getting cold feet?
Simple-minded as ever, Koji.
Now, now, that's what's good about Koji.
Zeon ground forces, Dr. Hell, and a mysterious invading army...
All this on the ground alone. What on earth is going on?
There was that Hyakki Empire too...
It's harder than the last war, since the situation's so much murkier.
You said it, I tell ya.
Hm? What's up, handsome?
He said events are already in motion...
This invasion... there's more to it. ...And don't call me handsome.
Hmph!
If we just smash 'em one by one, we'll hit whoever's hiding in the end.
Either way, Commander Hazuki, the Mazinger Team's joining the fight!
Kabuto, I'm counting on you. All right, on to our next destination.
